info.name: SkillGauge API
info.description:
# SkillGauge API

Backend REST API for the SkillGauge developer-assessment platform.

## Base URL
- `{{baseUrl}}` → `http://localhost:5000/api/v1` (all API requests).
- `{{serverUrl}}` → `http://localhost:5000` (root-level Health & Swagger requests only).

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a Bearer JWT access token:
`Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`
- Access token expires in 15 minutes, refresh token in 7 days (rotation on refresh).
- Public requests (register, login, callbacks, invitation/interview links, health) override the collection auth with **noauth**.

## Roles
- **CANDIDATE** — register/login, accept invitations, take attempts, save answers, submit, view own results, sit video interviews.
- **RECRUITER** — manage company & members, create problems/assessments, invite candidates, evaluate submissions, reports/analytics, video interviews, notes, dashboards.
- **ADMIN** — platform-wide users, companies, problems, payments, audit logs.

## Recommended flow
1. Login (recruiter) → accessToken + refreshToken + userId.
2. List/Create Company → companyId.
3. Create Problems (MCQ, Coding, Written) → problemId.
4. Create Assessment → assessmentId; Add Problem; Publish.
5. Invite Candidates → invitationId; (candidate) Accept Invitation / Accept by Token.
6. (candidate) Login → Start Attempt → Get Questions → Save Answers → Submit.
7. Evaluate (MCQ auto, Written manual, Coding sandbox) → Submissions/Evaluations.
8. Results → Reports & Analytics → Dashboard.

## Collection variables & default values
Dynamic IDs are captured by test scripts when you run the requests. Seeded values (from `npm run db:seed`) are pre-filled so most requests work immediately:

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:5000/api/v1` | API base URL |
| `serverUrl` | `http://localhost:5000` | Server root (health/swagger) |
| `adminEmail` / `adminPassword` | `admin@skillgauge.local` / `Admin123!` | Seeded admin login |
| `recruiterEmail` / `recruiterPassword` | `recruiter@techcorp.dev` / `Recruit123!` | Seeded recruiter login |
| `candidateEmail` / `candidatePassword` | `candidate@skillgauge.local` / `Candid8te!` | Seeded candidate login / invitee |
| `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `userId` | (empty) | Set by Register/Login |
| `companyId` | (empty) | Set by Create Company — seeded company id available via List Companies |
| `companyCode` | `TECHCOR-0001` | Seeded TechCorp join code |
| `problemId` | `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001` | Active problem (seeded MCQ; refreshed by Get Questions) |
| `mcqProblemId` | `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001` | Seeded MCQ problem |
| `writtenProblemId` | `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002` | Seeded WRITTEN problem |
| `codingProblemId` | `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003` | Seeded CODING problem |
| `assessmentId` | `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004` | Seeded assessment |
| `packageId` | `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005` | Seeded Starter Pack (10 credits / BDT 2000) |
| `invitationToken` | `demo-candidate-token-0001` | Seeded candidate invitation token |
| `invitationId`, `attemptId`, `answerId`, `mcqOptionId`, `submissionId`, `resultId`, `paymentId`, `transactionId`, `noteId`, `candidateId`, `notificationId`, `emailVerifyToken` | (empty) | Captured by test scripts |
| `interviewId`, `interviewQuestionId`, `interviewSessionId`, `interviewToken` | (empty) | Video-interview IDs captured by test scripts |

## Payments
SSLCommerz callbacks (`/success`, `/fail`, `/cancel`, `/ipn`) are public — no Bearer auth. In test/mock mode without SSLCommerz credentials use the `mockUrl` returned by Initiate Payment (see also Get Mock Gateway).

## Environment
- Run `npm run db:seed` first — the collection is pre-wired to the seeded users, problems, assessment, payment package and invitation token.
- Run requests top-to-bottom within each folder; cross-folder variables (accessToken, assessmentId, …) are shared at the collection level.

## Folders
Authentication · Users · Companies · Problems · Assessments · Invitations · Attempts · Anti-Cheating · Submissions · Evaluations · Results · Reports & Analytics · Payments · Dashboard · Notes · Notifications · Video Interviews · Interview Sessions (Candidate) · Admin · Health & Docs

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Register, login and token lifecycle. Register/Login/Refresh/Verify are public (noauth); Login defaults to the seeded recruiter credentials.

request.description: Register a new CANDIDATE account. Public. Password rules: 8–72 chars with at least one letter and one number. Optional fields: `phone`, `companyName`, `companyCode`, `companyId` (deprecated).
Register a new RECRUITER account. Public. Send optional `companyCode` (default `{{companyCode}}`) to join an existing company, or `companyName` to found one.

Authenticate and receive tokens (accessToken 15 min, refreshToken 7 d). Rate-limited: 5 requests / 15 min. Defaults = seeded recruiter; swap to `{{adminEmail}}`/`{{adminPassword}}` or `{{candidateEmail}}`/`{{candidatePassword}}`.
Verify an email address with the token from the verification email. Public. Fill `{{emailVerifyToken}}` first (seeded users are already verified).
Re-send the verification email. Public. Rate-limited: 5 requests / 15 min.
Exchange the refresh token for a new access token. Public. The old refresh token is revoked (rotation).
Revoke the refresh token. Requires a valid `{{refreshToken}}` in the body (access token optional).
Get the current user profile from the access token.

item.name: Users
item.description: Current-user profile management. All requests require `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

request.description: Get your profile (name, email, role, company, skills, …).
Update your profile (partial). Supported fields: `name`, `phone`, `bio`, `skills`, `experience`, `education`, `profileImageUrl`, `resumeUrl`, `jobTitle`.

body.raw:
{
  "bio": "Full-stack engineer focused on TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL.",
  "skills": [
    "typescript",
    "nodejs",
    "postgresql"
  ],
  "experience": 3,
  "jobTitle": "Senior Software Engineer",
  "phone": "+8801711111111"
}

request.description: Change your password. Rate-limited: 5 requests / 15 min. `newPassword`: 8–72 chars, ≥1 letter, ≥1 number. Defaults assume the seeded recruiter who has not changed their password yet.
Recent audit-log entries for the current user.

item.name: Companies
item.description: Company profile, membership and candidate pipeline. Write operations require RECRUITER (owner/admin) or ADMIN.

request.description: List companies with pagination, search and filtering. Query: `page`, `limit`, `q`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`. Use this to pick up the seeded TechCorp `companyId`.
Create a company (the recruiter becomes OWNER). **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN. Optional: `logo` (url), `description`, `website`, `industry`, `location`, `size`.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "TechCorp Solutions",
  "description": "A software company hiring top developers.",
  "website": "https://techcorp.example.com",
  "industry": "Software Development",
  "location": "Dhaka, Bangladesh",
  "size": "50-100"
}

request.description: Get a company by id (includes credits balance and join code).
Update a company (partial). **Role:** RECRUITER (owner/admin) or ADMIN. Fields: `name`, `logo`, `description`, `website`, `industry`, `location`, `size`.
Soft-delete a company. **Role:** RECRUITER (owner/admin) or ADMIN.
List company members and their roles (OWNER / ADMIN / MEMBER).
Add a member to the company by email. `role`: `OWNER` | `ADMIN` | `MEMBER` (default `MEMBER`).

exec: if (d.userId || (d.user && d.user.id) || d.id) pm.collectionVariables.set("userId", d.userId || (d.user && d.user.id) || d.id);

request.description: Change a member's role. Body: role = OWNER | ADMIN | MEMBER.
Remove a member from the company.
Company-level analytics: assessments, invitations, completion/pass rates, average score, credits, payment totals. **Role:** RECRUITER (member) or ADMIN.
Candidates invited to the company's assessments (paginated). Query: `page`, `limit`, `status` (recruitment status), `assessmentId`. Captures `candidateId` for Notes/Compare.
Update a candidate's recruitment status by invitation id. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN. Pipeline: INVITED → STARTED → COMPLETED → SHORTLISTED → INTERVIEW → HIRED, or REJECTED.

item.name: Problems
item.description: Question bank: MCQ, CODING and WRITTEN problems. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN for all write operations.

request.description: Create a multiple-choice problem. MCQ requires at least 2 `options` with exactly one `isCorrect: true`. Defaults: `difficulty: MEDIUM`, `points: 10`, `status: DRAFT`.
Create a coding problem. CODING requires at least 1 `testCase`. `timeLimit` seconds, `memoryLimit` MB. `allowedLanguages`: javascript, python, java, cpp, typescript, go, rust.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Sum of Two Numbers",
  "description": "Write a function `solve(a, b)` that returns the sum of a and b.\n\nThe sandbox calls your function with values read from the input and prints the result to stdout.",
  "type": "CODING",
  "difficulty": "EASY",
  "category": "algorithms",
  "points": 15,
  "timeLimit": 15,
  "memoryLimit": 256,
  "status": "ACTIVE",
  "testCases": [
    {
      "input": "1\n2",
      "expectedOutput": "3",
      "isHidden": false,
      "order": 0
    },
    {
      "input": "10\n20",
      "expectedOutput": "30",
      "isHidden": true,
      "order": 1
    },
    {
      "input": "-5\n5",
      "expectedOutput": "0",
      "isHidden": true,
      "order": 2
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Create a written (essay) problem. WRITTEN requires `expectedAnswer` — evaluation criteria such as keywords + guidance for the reviewer.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Explain Database Indexing",
  "description": "Explain what a database index is, when you should add one, and one trade-off of adding indexes.",
  "type": "WRITTEN",
  "difficulty": "MEDIUM",
  "category": "databases",
  "points": 10,
  "status": "ACTIVE",
  "expectedAnswer": {
    "keywords": [
      "index",
      "b-tree",
      "lookup",
      "write penalty",
      "storage"
    ],
    "guidance": "A good answer explains that an index accelerates lookups (B-tree), is chosen for frequently filtered/joined columns, and trades extra storage plus slower writes."
  }
}

request.description: List problems. Query: `page`, `limit`, `q`, `type`, `difficulty`, `category`, `status`, `tags`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`.
Keyword search across problem titles/descriptions. Query: `q`.
Get a problem by id (hidden test cases are never exposed).
Update a problem (partial). **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.
Soft-delete a problem. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.

item.name: Assessments
item.description: Assessment lifecycle (DRAFT → PUBLISHED → ACTIVE → CLOSED → ARCHIVED) plus attached problems. **Role:** RECRUITER (owner/admin) or ADMIN. Creating/publishing consumes company credits.

request.description: Create an assessment. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN (company must have credits). Required: `title` (≥3), `durationMinutes` (5–1440). Defaults shown below: `passingScore: 0`, `maxAttempts: 1`, `shuffleProblems/Options: false`, `showResults: true`, `antiCheatingEnabled: true`, `showCandidateRanking: true`, `resultStrategy: LATEST_SCORE`, `accessLevel: INVITATION_ONLY`. Optional: `startDate`, `endDate`, `accessCode`, `templateId`, `companyId`.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Junior Node.js Developer Assessment",
  "description": "Baseline screening assessment for junior backend engineers.",
  "instructions": "Answer all questions. The timer starts when you start the attempt and the server clock is the source of truth.",
  "durationMinutes": 45,
  "passingScore": 15,
  "maxAttempts": 1,
  "shuffleProblems": false,
  "shuffleOptions": false,
  "showResults": true,
  "antiCheatingEnabled": true,
  "showCandidateRanking": true,
  "resultStrategy": "LATEST_SCORE",
  "accessLevel": "INVITATION_ONLY"
}

request.description: List assessments. Query: `page`, `limit`, `q`, `status` (DRAFT/PUBLISHED/ACTIVE/CLOSED/ARCHIVED), `companyId`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`.
Get an assessment by id (includes settings, problems count, statistics).
Update an assessment (partial; only while DRAFT or PUBLISHED). **Role:** RECRUITER (owner/admin) or ADMIN. Same fields as create, all optional.
Soft-delete an assessment. **Role:** RECRUITER (owner/admin) or ADMIN.
Transition DRAFT → PUBLISHED (consumes one company credit). Candidates can then be invited.
Transition to CLOSED — stops accepting new attempts.
Create a DRAFT copy including problems, sections and settings. Captures the new copy into `assessmentId`.
Archive (DRAFT/PUBLISHED/CLOSED → ARCHIVED).
Restore an ARCHIVED assessment back to DRAFT.
Recompute all results from saved attempt answers and evaluations (after manual/scoring fixes).
Compare candidate performance. Query: `candidateIds` — comma-separated candidate user ids. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.
Status-change history (audit log) for the assessment.
Attach an existing problem to the assessment. Only `problemId` is required; optional: `points`, `isRequired`, `section`, `order`. Returns 201.
Problems attached to the assessment (ordered by `order`/`section`). Query: `page`, `limit`, `section`, `isRequired`.
Update the assessment-problem link (`points`, `isRequired`, `section`, `order`). Only allowed while the assessment has no active attempts.
Detach a problem from the assessment.

item.name: Invitations
item.description: Assessment invitations. Create/List/Resend = RECRUITER or ADMIN; Accept/Reject = CANDIDATE; token endpoints mirror the email link (lookup is public).

request.description: Invite candidates by email. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN. Each candidate: `email` (required), `expiresAt` (optional ISO datetime). Rate-limited: 10 per hour. Max 500 per call.

exec: const inv = Array.isArray(d) ? d[0] : (d.invitations && d.invitations[0]) || d;

request.description: List invitations for the assessment. Query: `page`, `limit`, `status` (PENDING/ACCEPTED/REJECTED/EXPIRED/COMPLETED). Captures `invitationId`.
Re-send the invitation email. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN. Rate-limited: 10 per hour.
Accept an invitation. **Role:** CANDIDATE.
Reject an invitation. **Role:** CANDIDATE.
Invitations for the current candidate. Query: `page`, `limit`, `status`. **Role:** CANDIDATE. Captures `invitationId`.
Public exam-link lookup used by the invitation email (seeded token: `demo-candidate-token-0001`). No auth. Query params may include `token` — here it is part of the path.
Accept the personal exam link after signing in. **Role:** CANDIDATE. Captures `invitationId`.

item.name: Attempts
item.description: Timed assessment attempts. Start/answers/submit = CANDIDATE (owner). The server clock is the source of truth for the timer. Status flow: NOT_STARTED → IN_PROGRESS → SUBMITTED → EVALUATING → COMPLETED (expired: AUTO_SUBMITTED).

request.description: Start a new timed attempt. **Role:** CANDIDATE with an ACCEPTED invitation (maxAttempts enforced). Returns `expiresAt` computed server-side.
Attempt details: assessment, status, startedAt/expiresAt/submittedAt, saved answers, score, maxScore. Ownership enforced.
Server-authoritative remaining time for an in-progress attempt: `remainingTimeSeconds`, `serverTime`, `status`. Roles: owner CANDIDATE, company RECRUITER, ADMIN.
Anti-cheating summary: `riskScore`, `riskLevel` (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH), event counts, unique IPs/devices, sessions and full timeline. Ownership enforced.
All questions for the in-progress attempt (hidden test cases excluded). Captures `problemId` and `mcqOptionId` for Save Answer.

exec: const mcq = data.find((q) => q.problem && Array.isArray(q.problem.options) && q.problem.options.length > 0);

request.description: Save an answer (MCQ/written/coding). **Role:** CANDIDATE. MCQ: `{ answer: { selectedOptionId } }`. Written: `{ answer: { text } }`. Coding: `{ code, programmingLanguage }` (javascript/python/java/cpp/typescript/go/rust). Either `answer` or `code` is required.
Update a saved answer before submission. **Role:** CANDIDATE. Send `answer` and/or `code` + `programmingLanguage`.
Submit the attempt — triggers automatic evaluation (MCQ auto, written pending manual score, coding in the sandbox) and result calculation.
Current candidate's attempts. Query: `page`, `limit`, `status`. **Role:** CANDIDATE.

item.name: Anti-Cheating
item.description: Attempt integrity events (owner CANDIDATE). Event types: TAB_SWITCH, WINDOW_BLUR, WINDOW_FOCUS, FULLSCREEN_EXIT, COPY, PASTE, MULTIPLE_SESSION, SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY.

request.description: Report an anti-cheating event. **Role:** CANDIDATE. IP and user-agent are stored server-side.
List the event timeline for an attempt (type, timestamp, metadata, IP, user-agent).

item.name: Submissions
item.description: Coding submissions evaluated in the sandbox. Statuses: PENDING → RUNNING → PASSED | FAILED | PARTIAL | ERROR | MANUAL_REVIEW. Rate-limited (60/min).

request.description: Create a coding submission for formal evaluation. **Role:** CANDIDATE. Body: `attemptId`, `problemId`, `code`, `programmingLanguage` (javascript/python/java/cpp/typescript/go/rust). Rate-limited: 60/min.
Submission detail incl. execution status, metrics and test-case results. Ownership enforced.
(Re-)run the evaluation for a submission. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.
All submissions for an attempt. Query: `page`, `limit`.
Submissions across all attempts of the assessment. Query: `page`, `limit`, `status`, `problemId`. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.

item.name: Evaluations
item.description: Per-problem evaluations: MCQ auto-scored, written manually scored, coding from the sandbox. Manual scoring = RECRUITER or ADMIN.

request.description: Written evaluations still awaiting manual scoring (includes attempt, candidate, problem and the saved answer). Query: `page`, `limit`. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.
Manually score a written answer. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN. Body: `attemptId`, `problemId`, `score` (0–1000), optional `feedback`.
All evaluations for an attempt (score, max, feedback, source).
Evaluations across all attempts of the assessment. Query: `page`, `limit`, `status`. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.

item.name: Results
item.description: Final computed results. Candidates only see results once the assessment's `showResults`/release policy permits.

request.description: Result by id: totalPoints, earnedPoints, percentage, passed, timeTakenSeconds, per-question `items`, evaluationFeedback. Ownership enforced.
Per-skill scoring breakdown: skills[] with totalPoints, earnedPoints, questions, percentage, plus overallPercentage and passed.
Current candidate's released results (paginated). Query: `page`, `limit`. Captures `resultId`.
Results for an assessment (ordered by earnedPoints desc; includes candidate + attempt). Query: `page`, `limit`. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.

item.name: Reports & Analytics
item.description: Recruiter/admin reporting. CSV export returns a text/csv attachment.

request.description: Full report: candidate/completed counts, average/highest/lowest score, pass rate, average completion time, question performance, ranking. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.
Download the assessment report as CSV (`Content-Disposition: attachment`). **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.
Analytics: invitations, started/completed attempts, completion rate, average/median score, pass rate, average time, most failed questions, performance distribution. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.
List company-level reports. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.
Company report summary: candidate count, average score, pass rate, credits consumed, etc. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.

item.name: Payments
item.description: SSLCommerz credit packages. Callbacks (/success, /fail, /cancel, /ipn) and package listing are PUBLIC (noauth). Without gateway credentials use the mock gateway returned by Initiate Payment.

request.description: List purchasable credit packages (public). Seeded default: `{{packageId}}` = Starter Pack — 10 credits / BDT 2000.
Mock SSLCommerz gateway page used in test mode (no store credentials). Public.

Start a credit-package purchase. **Role:** authenticated. Rate-limited: 10/min. Body: `packageId` (uuid), optional `companyId`. Returns `gatewayUrl` or `mockUrl` in test mode, plus `payment.id` and `transactionId`.

exec: if (d.gatewayUrl || d.mockUrl) console.log("Open gateway URL in browser:", d.gatewayUrl || d.mockUrl);

request.description: SSLCommerz success callback (public). Verifies the transaction with the gateway before marking the payment PAID. Body: `tran_id` (and gateway fields).
SSLCommerz failure callback (public). Marks the payment FAILED.
SSLCommerz cancel callback (public). Marks the payment CANCELLED.
SSLCommerz Instant Payment Notification webhook (public, idempotent — safe to retry). `status`: VALID / FAILED / CANCELLED.
Browser-redirect variant of the success callback — SSLCommerz redirects the customer's browser with GET query params (`tran_id`, `val_id`, …). Public.
Browser-redirect variant of the fail callback (GET query params). Public.
Browser-redirect variant of the cancel callback (GET query params). Public.
Payment by id: status, package, amounts, gateway metadata.
List payments. Query: `page`, `limit`, `status` (PENDING/PAID/FAILED/CANCELLED/REFUNDED).

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Aggregated summaries, role-scoped.

request.description: Recruiter/ADMIN dashboard: summary (assessments, invitations, attempts, results, pass/completion rates, problems, pending evaluations), recentAssessments, recentResults. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN.
Candidate dashboard: summary (invitations, attempts, results, pass rate), upcomingAssessments, recentResults. **Role:** CANDIDATE.

item.name: Notes
item.description: Private recruiter notes attached to a candidate. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN for writes. Visibility: recruiters see public notes + their own private notes; candidates see only their own; admins see all.

request.description: Create a note on a candidate. **Role:** RECRUITER or ADMIN. Body: `candidateId` (uuid, required), `content` (1–5000), optional `assessmentId`, `companyId`, `isPrivate` (default false).
Notes for a candidate. Query: `page`, `limit`, `assessmentId`. Captures `noteId`.
Update a note (`content`, `isPrivate`). Author or ADMIN only; at least one field required.
Soft-delete a note. Author or ADMIN only.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Per-user in-app notifications, scoped to the current user. Types: ASSESSMENT_INVITATION, ASSESSMENT_COMPLETED, RESULT_AVAILABLE, PAYMENT_SUCCESS, PAYMENT_FAILED, ASSESSMENT_EXPIRING.

request.description: My notifications. Query: `page`, `limit`, `status` (UNREAD/READ). Captures `notificationId`.
Unread count: `{ "unreadCount": 3 }`.
Mark a single notification as read (owned by the current user).
Mark all of my notifications as read. Returns `{ "updated": 5 }`.

item.name: Video Interviews
item.description: Proctored AI video interviews (recruiter/admin side). Create → publish → invite/session links → review reports. Defaults: seniority MID, questionCount 10, questionTimeSeconds 300 (5 min), passScore 60, proctoring/AI review on, terminateOnCritical on, maxViolations 2.

request.description: Question-bank metadata per technology (id, label, size) plus default settings.
Browse built-in bank questions. Query: `technology` (required, e.g. javascript/nodejs/python/sql/react), `q` (optional keyword). Use the returned `key` values with Add Bank Questions.
Search existing platform users to pre-fill invites. Query: `q`, `limit` (1–50).

Create an interview. Required: `title`, `technology`, `startsAt`, `expiresAt` (window is mandatory; example below uses a 2030 window — adjust as needed). Draws `questionCount` random bank questions unless `useBankQuestions: false`. Optional `customQuestions[]` (prompt, hints, expectedKeywords, modelAnswer, timeSeconds, maxScore, topic, difficulty).

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Node.js Backend Screening",
  "description": "Proctored AI video interview for backend engineers.",
  "jobRole": "Backend Engineer",
  "technology": "nodejs",
  "seniority": "MID",
  "questionCount": 5,
  "questionTimeSeconds": 300,
  "shuffleQuestions": true,
  "hintsEnabled": true,
  "proctoringEnabled": true,
  "terminateOnCritical": true,
  "aiReviewEnabled": true,
  "passScore": 60,
  "maxViolations": 2,
  "startsAt": "2030-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
  "expiresAt": "2030-12-31T23:59:59.000Z",
  "showScoreToCandidate": true,
  "sendResultToCandidate": true,
  "useBankQuestions": true,
  "customQuestions": []
}

request.description: List interviews. Query: `page`, `limit`, `q`, `status` (DRAFT/ACTIVE/CLOSED/ARCHIVED), `technology`, `companyId`.
Interview detail: full question set, public candidate link and session stats. Captures `interviewToken` from the candidate link.

exec: const link = d.candidateLink || d.link || d.publicLink || d.joinUrl || "";

request.description: Update interview settings (partial): timings, pass mark, proctoring, AI review, shuffling, technologies, status, …
Archive the interview (soft delete).
Publish — the public candidate link goes live within the startsAt/expiresAt window.
Stop accepting new candidates.
Re-open a closed interview. Optional body: new `expiresAt` (ISO datetime); when omitted an expired window is extended by a default window.
Redraw the random bank sample. `keepCustomQuestions` (default true) preserves organisation-authored questions in place.
